Subject: Launch position and decision needed on October 8 staging demo

Hi Avery,

Here is where the launch stands. The October 8, 2026 launch date was tentative, and the security review now completes October 12 at the earliest. Release also needs completed approval, so we cannot commit to a production date yet. The review may require remediation, and no new production date is authorized at this point.

The team is working through this carefully, and I am confident in how they are handling the review and keeping the work on track.

One option remains open. A staging demo can still happen on October 8 using synthetic data. Nia owns the security review, and you decide whether to accept the staging demo.

Could you let me know by [date] whether you want to proceed with the October 8 staging demo? I will confirm the details with the team once I hear from you.

Best,
Jordan
Engagement Lead
